Chosen apps pause after 2 idle seconds in a side window and stop using power. Tap the window and the app returns to the main window, running again at once. An app playing audio or video, in a call, or in the top wide window is never paused.
Games, video, music, maps and chat are not recommended: a paused game may be closed by the system or drop its match, and a paused chat shows no new messages.
